name: Control Systems Engineering
description: Fourier and Laplace transforms; mathematical modeling of simple physical systems; transfer function; block diagrams; transient response analysis; performance specifications in time and frequency domain; steady state error and error constants; proportional, integral, derivative, PD and PID control; realization of standard controllers using hydraulic, pneumatic, electronic circuits; stability, Bode plots, Nyquist stability criterion; control system design using root locus and frequency response; lead and lag compensation; introduction to modern control: state space representation; control with state feedback; digital control using microcontrollers. Practical on first/second order systems, control of various parameters, microcontroller, control system analysis and design using MATLAB and SIMULINK.
